identification: Large full-leather gilt-tooled ledger-format Victorian manuscript commonplace book with alphabet thumb index, handwritten recipes, parlour games and gunpowder trial notes (dated Sept 1869 or 1884), plus loose letters, a pencil sketch, printed circulars and an envelope with stamps. Author, place and provenance unknown; Tasmanian link unproven.

viewing_check: Look for a name, address or place on the flyleaf, inside covers, letters, envelope and circulars (Tasmanian or other colonial link is what lifts value). Read the dates on the loose letters and postmarks, and the stamps (colony and issue). Check the pencil sketch for a signature. Confirm the gunpowder entry year (1869 or 1884) and whether it names a Tasmanian place or people. Check how much of the book is actually written and whether pages are detached.
